title: Jesus... I Parked Outside Church And Couldn't Go In
topic: returning to church after years away

bible.text: “Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I parked outside church this morning. I never went in. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Five years away. I sat in the car and watched everyone walk past my window.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I saw you. You drove there. That was not nothing.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But they all know why I left. They will stare at me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Some might. I was not waiting at the door to stare. I was waiting to say your name.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if I walk in and still feel nothing? Then I wasted the drive.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then sit in the back and feel nothing with Me. I am not asking you to feel ready. Just come in.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The past drove you to that parking lot. It does not get to keep you in the car.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What is the door you keep parking outside of? 🙏
